text:
Courtney: Heads up — POC with Acme Corp (Enterprise). 3-month POC -> potential 12-month commit. Sales asked for 28% discount + price protection for renewal. Need deal desk path + CPQ field guidance. Anyone take?

Raj: Adding context — ARR potential ~$480k if scaled, committing to ~2M tokens/mo. Salesforce opp id 0065x0000. We should encode Commit_Level__c and Discount_Band__c on the opp. Rate card link: https://redwood.internal/ratecards/2026-q1 (internal).

Elaine: FYI — 28% pushes this into exec territory. Rule: >25% -> Tier-3 escalation (exec + finance). CPQ fields to set: Commit_Level__c = "12m_commit", Discount_Category__c = "Tier-3", Special_Terms_Attached__c = "true". Also add Price_Protection_Window__c = "12 months".

Sam: Can we auto-route to the deal desk queue `deal-desk-escalations` with a 48h SLA for initial review? If exec approval required, escalate to `sales-lead` + `vp-sales` and mark emergency SLA = 4h.

Courtney: Sounds good. Who will open the deal desk ticket and attach the draft SOW + commit worksheet? @Raj can you submit? Also pinging Legal for price-protection language review.

Raj: Submitting now. Ticket created: DD-15439. Attached: draft SOW, commit worksheet, rate calc. Pushing CPQ snippet to opp config:

```
Opportunity.Commit_Level__c = "12m_commit"
Opportunity.Discount_Category__c = "Tier-3"
Opportunity.Special_Terms_Attached__c = "true"
Opportunity.Price_Protection_Window__c = "12 months"
Opportunity.Approval_Path__c = "deal-desk-escalations > exec"
```

DealDeskBot: Ticket DD-15439 created, status: awaiting-deal-desk-review. SLA: 48h to first response. Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-15439

Legal: Quick read — 12-month price protection ok with a cap. Need to avoid auto-renew at higher rate; suggest clause: "Customer's unit price will not increase by more than 5% at renewal during the protection window." I'll upload a redline to DD-15439 by EOD.

Elaine: Also note for CPQ workflows: set Apply_Commit_Discount = true so billing pipeline consumes committed rates. Add Discount_Justification = "Strategic POC -> enterprise expansion" on the opp.

Courtney: Thanks team. I'll follow up to confirm approval in SF within SLA and mark thread closed once DD-15439 is approved or declined. :thumbsup:
